mapper.select: SELECT id, source_module, msg_id, biz_id, exchange_name, routing_key, topic, payload, status, retry_cnt, next_retry_time, last_error, source_create_time, source_update_time, collect_time, collect_version, resend_state, resend_request_id, resend_attempt_cnt, resend_last_time, resend_last_error, row_version, create_time, update_time FROM op_mq_fail_msg WHERE ( resend_state IN (0, 2) OR ( resend_state = 3 AND resend_last_time IS NOT NULL AND resend_last_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{doingTimeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
